e979351750656a28ceb9022db535b158c7cfbbed.sourceText: 例如，其他条件都满足时：同一个坡上的点，若被算成比这一小片地面高6 cm，会低于当前10 cm障碍门槛；若地面高度估计偏低，把它算成高15 cm，就可能被画成障碍。这里是**局部地面高度差，不是整条坡的总高度**。调整地面估计或抬高障碍门槛，可能减少坡面误判，也可能让真实低障碍被忽略，不能只看坡能不能通过。
e979351750656a28ceb9022db535b158c7cfbbed.translatedText: For example, when all other conditions are met: a point on the same slope, if calculated as 6 cm higher than this small patch of ground, will be below the current 10 cm obstacle threshold; if the ground height is underestimated and it is calculated as 15 cm higher, it may be drawn as an obstacle\. This is**local ground height difference, not the total height of the entire slope**\. Adjusting the ground estimate or raising the obstacle threshold may reduce slope misjudgments, but may also cause real low obstacles to be ignored; you cannot judge only by whether the slope can be passed\.
